A cinematic fashion transformation scene:
A woman in a casual outfit sits gracefully at center stage.
A glowing curtain of light descends slowly from above, surrounding her in a soft radiance.
Behind the curtain, her glowing silhouette smoothly moves — she gently rises to stand, maintaining continuous motion and posture.
As the curtain lifts upward again, she is now wearing an elegant evening gown, seamlessly continuing her movement from before.
The entire transition feels fluid, magical, and natural, with consistent silhouette, smooth motion, and cinematic lighting.
